purpose: Teach: レター/高性能/撮ら/商用/出所/明細/否め/バージョンアップ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時、手書きのレター、お得意様に、送っていたな、私。
lines.en: In the beginning, I used to send hand-written letters to our most valued customers.
lines.style: Warm, nostalgic opening. Settled pace, as if remembering something he's proud of. Voice steady with age and quiet certainty. The slight satisfaction of someone who built something right.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。高性能の新製品、創業者の発想が、活きています。
lines.en: Yes, sir. The founder's vision is truly alive in this high-performance product.
lines.style: Respectful and genuine. Measured cadence, eyes slightly forward — showing he understands the weight of continuity. Not flattering, but affirming with quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、私の写真、勝手に撮らないでくれって、頼んでたな。
lines.en: When I was younger, I used to ask people not to photograph me without permission.
lines.style: Reflective, almost amused at himself. Slight pause before the request — remembering his own younger caution. Voice softer, more intimate, like he's sharing something he doesn't often mention.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。商用拡大、創業者の悲願、達成しております。
lines.en: Yes, sir. We have achieved the founder's great ambition of commercial expansion.
lines.style: Clear and steady. Light emphasis on 「達成」 — a moment of quiet pride in what's been accomplished under his watch. Composed but genuinely pleased.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 情報の出所、創業期から、私、こだわってきた。
lines.en: I've always been particular about where our information comes from — since the very beginning.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Direct, with the quiet authority of someone who built standards that still hold. Slight weight on 「こだわってきた」 — this matters and always has.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業時の経費明細、社史館に、保管中です。
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're keeping the expense records from those founding years in the company museum.
lines.style: Informative, attentive. A straightforward statement delivered with care — showing he understands why these details matter. No rush, just clarity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 時代の変化、否めないことだ、柔軟に、対応しろ。
lines.en: The times change — there's no denying that. You must adapt, but thoughtfully.
lines.style: Calm authority with a light touch of urgency. Not lecturing — advising. Slight pause before 「柔軟に」, then a gentle firmness. The voice of someone who has seen change and survived it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。社是のバージョンアップ、慎重に、進めます、変わらぬ精神で。
lines.en: Yes, sir. We will carefully update our company principles, while keeping our spirit unchanged.
lines.style: Solemn and resolute. A formal close: respectful, thoughtful pacing. Slight lift on 「変わらぬ精神で」 — the affirmation of what endures. Steady eye contact through the finish.
